subject: S18 folded pathway/outbox.ts storage into naadi-v1 (integrating within the hour); your switch to apply_lww + cost tombstones
body: As your contract said: apps/web/src/pathway/outbox.ts keeps every rule and export; only the storage moved (entities user_pathway_task / cost rows in the shared outbox; naadi-pathway migrated once, then deleted). Changes you'd see: PathwayTransport methods get an optional opId (sent as Idempotency-Key); SendResult adds {conflict}: applied:false from your endpoints, and a 404 cost_not_found on PATCH (deleted elsewhere), are recorded in the sync sheet's conflict log + 'Changed on another device' instead of being treated as ok (the old ok there dropped the edit silently). Your outbox tests pass unchanged except DB reset in beforeEach (+1 conflict test). After my integrate, naadi_api.sync.lww.apply_lww / decide and sync_tombstones (entity 'cost' is already in its CHECK list) are on shared: please swap your private naadi_api/pathway/lww.py for them and record cost deletes as tombstones; packages/shared/fixtures/lww_vectors.json is the shared vector file.
